answer: SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000;

WITH cust_2013 AS (
  SELECT y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total2013
  FROM yearmonth y
  WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY y.CustomerID
),
seg_cust AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, cy.total2013
  FROM customers c JOIN cust_2013 cy ON c.CustomerID = cy.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT Segment, AVG(total2013) AS annual_avg
  FROM seg_cust sc
  WHERE total2013 = (SELECT MIN(total2013) FROM seg_cust sc2 WHERE sc2.Segment = sc.Segment)
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='LAM') AS sme_minus_lam,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='KAM') AS lam_minus_kam,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='SME') AS kam_minus_sme;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment='SME' AND Currency='CZK') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment='SME' AND Currency='EUR') AS more_sme_czk_than_eur;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency='EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS pct_eur FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE substr(t.Date,1,4) || substr(t.Date,6,2) = '201306';
